headline: Trump intensifies ‘Economic Fury’ against China and Iran
summary: The Trump administration has introduced new sanctions described as designed to directly attack China's economic sector. The measures are part of an 'Economic Fury' campaign against China and Iran.
why: Sanctions on China and Iran can disrupt trade flows, energy purchases and corporate exposure, affecting multinationals and commodity markets.
